install_tell: docker run -p 8080:8080 quay.io/debezium/debezium-ui — no auth on UI or REST API by default. Requires Kafka Connect backend (port 8083) to be configured separately.
misconfig_patterns: Debezium UI exposed with no auth (default) — exposes connector list, config, and status including DB credentials embedded in connector configs
Kafka Connect REST API (port 8083) exposed — connector CRUD, includes plaintext DB creds in connector config responses

response_markers: JSON array of connector names OR empty array []
active_probe.false_positive_check: Debezium UI title is distinctive. Kafka Connect /connectors returns JSON array — conjunctive-check on Content-Type + array structure.

deployment_tells: Connector configs returned by /connectors/{name}/config include DB connection strings with plaintext passwords — high-value exfil target
Debezium runs on top of Kafka Connect — port 8083 is the Connect REST API, port 8080 is the optional UI
Common pattern: Debezium UI at 8080, Kafka Connect at 8083, Kafka broker at 9092 — three surfaces on same host
pivot_paths: GET /connectors/{name}/status -> connector state, task offsets, lag metrics
POST /connectors -> create new connector (if no auth — arbitrary DB connection injection)
